Window types we fabricate

All windows are made from multi-chamber PVC profile with steel reinforcement, fusion-welded corners and sealed insulated glass units. Any type can be combined into a larger assembly.

Casement

Hinged on the side and cranks open outward. Best seal of any opening window — ideal for bedrooms and living rooms.

Awning

Hinged at the top and opens outward from the bottom. Can stay open in the rain; common above picture windows and in basements.

Slider

One sash slides horizontally past the other. Economical and easy to operate; a good fit for wide openings.

Single / double hung

Sashes move vertically. Classic look for older Winnipeg homes.

Picture (fixed)

Does not open. Maximum glass, maximum insulation value — often combined with casements or awnings on the sides.

Tilt & turn

European style: tilts inward from the top for ventilation, or swings fully open for cleaning and egress.

Glass options

  • Double or triple pane sealed units
  • Low-E coatings, argon fill
  • Warm-edge spacer bars
  • Tempered glass where code requires it
  • Obscure / frosted glass for bathrooms
  • Internal grilles (muntins) in several patterns

Frame & hardware

  • White, or laminated exterior colours and woodgrains
  • Multi-point locking hardware
  • Integrated screens
  • Brickmould, jamb extensions and nailing fin to suit your wall
  • Custom sizes and shapes

Not sure which type suits your opening?

We'll recommend the right combination during the measurement visit.
